> Target: establish that the core’s common relations are indispensable across all wisdom under discussion, and thereby the foundational status of the whole core.

<a id="progress--已接通"></a>
## Progress

1. Moral judgments: eight constructed applications state grounds, judgments and reversal conditions under fixed living significance, the practical commitments and E; they are philosophical applications, not historical coverage or independent evidence. [study](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/CORE-CONSTRAINT-AND-WISDOM.md#deriving-a-family-of-moral-judgments)
2. Judgment content: independently specified content, grounds, scope and strength connect five aspects of wisdom to the formal conditions, keeping their differences; bounded identification corrects perpetual-revision readings. [study](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/CORE-CONSTRAINT-AND-WISDOM.md#necessity-through-judgment-content)
3. Tacit practice and forgetting: descriptive omission is separated from actual transformation; sitting-and-forgetting reduces to neither judgment nor compression, and keeping local skill relations does not show a rival accepts the full core. [study](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/CORE-CONSTRAINT-AND-WISDOM.md#tacit-understanding-and-forgetting)
4. Letting go: one connection separates changed shared support from changed attention/experience; tranquility needs no payoff, fit ending no endless individual continuation; projection theorems do not prove actual forgetting beneficial. [study](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/CORE-CONSTRAINT-AND-WISDOM.md#letting-go-and-operative-relations)
5. Theoretical wisdom: content validity, epistemic warrant and formed understanding are separated, with three candidate common relations among them; the old closure results locate the universal proof burden but supply no wisdom correspondence. [study](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/CORE-CONSTRAINT-AND-WISDOM.md#one-root-and-distinct-grounds)
6. Grasp: chance discovery, direct apprehension and redundant grounds defeat universal demands for reliable origins or individually indispensable routes; acquired binding locates content use, its meanings, categories and coverage supplied. [study](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/CORE-CONSTRAINT-AND-WISDOM.md#discovery-grasp-and-operative-ground)
7. Content dependence: substitution and equal-value capture results locate attributed dependence; valid derivation beside actual use does not show their joint necessity, and composition under a coarse reading does not certify its grounds. [study](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/CORE-CONSTRAINT-AND-WISDOM.md#content-dependence-and-composition)
8. From reading to operative relations: existing interfaces preserve realization and supplied support, but writing wisdom as runs and runs as worlds does not make the whole core necessary; a shared label is no semantic correspondence. [study](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/CORE-CONSTRAINT-AND-WISDOM.md#from-reading-to-operative-relations)
9. One connected theory: completed branch results are consumed, not rebuilt; eight pure-core adapters compose content fidelity with selection preservation and loss, for arbitrary Frame content without numerical requirements. [study](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/CORE-CONSTRAINT-AND-WISDOM.md#wisdom-within-one-connected-theory)
10. Continuing revision: checked operations feed successor revision as old distinctions retire, so keeping every choice is unnecessary there; this neither defines wisdom, licenses arbitrary loss, nor guarantees recovering a retired distinction. [study](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/CORE-CONSTRAINT-AND-WISDOM.md#grounds-use-and-continuing-revision)
11. Fallible capacity: independent coverage/error commitments constrain how differences enter, allowing error and abstention; this certifies no actual weights and supplies no ethical permission or complete justification of false belief. [study](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/CORE-CONSTRAINT-AND-WISDOM.md#fallible-capacity-and-necessary-relations)
12. Present realization: theoretical grasp, lived change in contemplation, and fulfillment or release are located; no experience, living reading or ranking is certified; the rest witness omits tranquil experience and shows no actual rest worse. [study](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/CORE-CONSTRAINT-AND-WISDOM.md#present-realization-and-constitutive-necessity)
13. Common operational factor: exact accounts of one joining content share unavoidable content without source minimality; internal events that continuation questions alone can omit must be joined to content, grounds and actual uptake. [study](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/CORE-CONSTRAINT-AND-WISDOM.md#common-operational-structure-and-wisdom-content)
14. One relation for content and continuation: three pure-core adapters join content fidelity to joint content/step preservation, needing fidelity only where R relates configurations and keeping processes, actions and R. [study](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/CORE-CONSTRAINT-AND-WISDOM.md#one-relation-for-content-and-continuation)
15. Alternative action: records, warranted laws and generated responses are distinguished; static accounts keeping the relations stand equally, and a record class missing actual laws cannot refute the full theory. [study](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/CORE-CONSTRAINT-AND-WISDOM.md#static-description-and-warranted-alternatives)
16. Fallible acceptance takes up warranted support, not a sufficient ground of truth, resting on the contestable epistemic candidate rather than living significance or an error bound alone; false content is neither knowledge nor automatically excused. [study](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/CORE-CONSTRAINT-AND-WISDOM.md#fallible-acceptance-and-operative-grounds)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- Retain both authorized components, necessary relations and generative explanation; local success conditions cannot simply be renamed full wisdom.
- Following Ren’s correction, pursue morality as appraisal of becoming through universal generative principles, without requiring a rival’s assent. G0 now follows with Unrestricted as a condition (chapter section 6.4; the theory does not assert the condition); the applicable A, L, J/C, practical articulation and actual correspondence E remain explicit, not conclusions of bare dynamics.

**Not required by this target:**

- Actual formation, concern and affect, and sufficiency are distinct parts of the full target, not gates imposed wholesale on this necessity task.
- Premise-free warrant for all metareasoning, complete mathematical ontology and experience generation are separate goals, not added gates.
- No acquisition route is universally prescribed: chance origins may be followed by verification, direct apprehension need not use explicit calculation, and redundant grounds may substitute.
- Necessary relations require neither explicit rules, maximal information, perpetual revision nor preservation of every old form; fidelity does not demand lossless transformation.
- Exact explanatory coverage demands no omniscience of each wise person, and the all-term fidelity criterion does not require each wise episode to preserve every position.
- Not every wisdom claim undertakes two-sided error bounds, and counterfactual reasoning is not imposed on every theoretical, contemplative or ending achievement.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Reused conditional results and the formal laws of wisdom-root-part-one do not by themselves prove wisdom coverage or complete the root; formal adequacy certifies no wisdom reading or actual acquisition history.
- Content validity is not actual understanding, formal binding is not human understanding, and explanatory fidelity alone does not prove constitutive necessity.
- The three common relations are no exhaustive definition or minimal axiom list; their joint requirement of the full substantive core does not follow from representability or separately suitable readings.
- Explaining each basis row of a finite root separately is not explaining its whole closure pointwise.
- Continuing revision and productive return do not alone establish content warrant or ethical purpose.
- A common operational factor is no sufficient root for all wisdom content: the history instance agrees on every joining context despite different event words; this bounds the question scope, and the full core keeps the histories. Witness: `Generative.ExplanatoryHistoryInterfaces.different_histories_same_required_interface`.
- Preserving state selections across configurations does not certify claim fidelity: a literal reading of the same process keeps the former and fails the latter. Witness: `Becoming.Frame.literal_claims_separate_preservation`.
- Shared claim types do not establish adequate meaning, and possible courses certify neither actual acquisition nor duties.
- Loop certifies neither moral superiority nor an empirical social law; the constructed archive case supplies evidential adequacy explicitly and does not identify every reasonable belief with wisdom.
- **Counterexample:** Sufficient descriptions need not admit a still-sufficient common coarsest representation. [source](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/history/root-foundation/WISDOM-RESPONSE-NECESSITY.md)
- **Counterexample:** A true risk bound can accompany actual failure; infallible success cannot simply define all wisdom. [source](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/history/root-foundation/WISDOM-FALLIBLE-JUDGMENT.md)
- **Counterexample:** Differentiated wisdom and the universal-principle route are retained. The fixed selector’s default in incomparable cases meets nondomination without unique superiority; constructed applications and existing mathematical results do not substitute for actual correspondence or historical coverage. [source](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/CORE-CONSTRAINT-AND-WISDOM.md)

**Standard boundaries:** A relation omitted by a weaker description does not refute the fuller account. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation.

<a id="evidence--证据"></a>
## Evidence

Philosophical correspondence and author counterreview, with limited primary-source readings (Aristotle, Zhuangzi, Dreyfus, Pritchard, Gettier, Tiberius). Formal evidence: declarations reused from 30 bound proof sources, each matched to its passed receipt by source hash, and a pure-core adapter module whose eleven declarations have empty axiom reports, with prelude compilation and kernel checks; some reused peripheral declarations depend on propext, Quot.sound or Classical.choice. Receipts are under sources. No empirical test or independent review.

Canonical source: [CORE-CONSTRAINT-AND-WISDOM.md](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/CORE-CONSTRAINT-AND-WISDOM.md)

<a id="next--下一步"></a>
## Next

Complete the substantive necessity of the whole core for independently specified wisdom: align content, grounds, uptake and claimed activity, explain why the selected claims and relations preserve the same achievement, and compare faithful alternatives.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Each connection of independently specified wisdom content to the core’s formal conditions is listed under Progress with its boundary. Need, actual continuation, fulfillment and discharge cannot be erased. The timed branch excludes differently informative initial states; theoretical or contemplative content without this discrimination commitment keeps its own constitutive burden, and the abstract bound and native physical conditions stay separate. General-Frame G0 and relevance_least already accommodate present realization; the possibility, presence and rest boundaries prevent replacing that content with future feasibility or activity counts. Multivalued recovery keeps richer questions and finiteness. Constitutive binding, acquired content and continuing support keep separate roles; wisdom correspondence across different instances is interpretive, not a formal state composition. Binding, actual history and normative arguments supply the real content of the claims; the formal interfaces are no longer missing mechanisms. Knowledge, reasonable acceptance, practical permission and subsequent responsibility remain distinct; final truth does not replace historical warrant.

### History

- 2026-10-08: migrated existing result identity and scope; no new theorem or relocated source.
- 2026-10-08: retained the unchanged open target while integrating completed goal evaluation and the limited-judgment correction; updated the read and extended core source, without reopening completed mechanisms.
- 2026-10-08: added scoped comparisons of three primary texts in the existing study, distinguishing episodes, capacities and full explanation. The faithful comparator is not excluded and the full target remains open; no extra result identity or mathematical count.
- 2026-10-08: section 13 makes the faithful comparison concrete through two primary texts and the existing case, distinguishing retained relations from disputed universal grounding. The next connection is narrowed; no new result identity or theorem.
- 2026-10-08: Ren corrects the Dancy-led framing and directs the affirmative route through morality as appraisal of becoming under this theory’s universal principles. Section 14 reuses established results while retaining section 13’s sources and anti-circularity limits; no axiom-free gate or completed mechanism is reopened.
- 2026-10-08: section 15 develops eight judgments from shared premises along the becoming-appraisal route, stating reversal conditions, nonunique choice and error diagnoses. This adds philosophical applications without recounting existing theorems; constructed roles and cases are not independent historical evidence.
- 2026-10-12 P75: following Ren's “please, fully complete, 我觉得理更像是对结构和变化的规律的建模 finish wisdom root, and resolve the undissolved”, the formal part is completed at the scope Part I reaches, in the new record wisdom-root-part-one and §93 of the integration note; by the registry's rule the target stays a target, its open part named as the correspondence of actual formation, the formation of concern and affect, and sufficiency; 理 is read as Ren reads it. The claim is unchanged.
- 2026-10-13: Section 16 connects judgment content to necessary relations, retaining five differentiated forms, common response and limited judgment. Bounded identification corrects perpetual-revision readings; reorganization of accessible experience is distinguished from new external evidence. P75 retains formal-completion credit, while universal wisdom coverage remains open; no new result identity or mathematical proof.
- 2026-10-13 continuation: Section 17 compares tacit skilled practice, distinguishing absence of explicit representation from absent relations, and uses sitting-and-forgetting to locate a transformation coverage obligation. Existing constant-description and registered-future preservation proofs exclude vacuous law-carrying; no new mathematical result or full-scope completion.
- 2026-10-13 Section 18 connects letting-go and ending: specified primary content distinguishes changed shared support from changed attention/experience; transfer/discharge and P91 delimit the connection. Counterreview retains appropriate ending, tranquility itself, adaptation without ethical warrant and stronger non-discrimination accounts. This local connection is supplied; full necessity coverage remains open, with no new mathematical result.
- 2026-10-13 Section 19 tests the common argument with theoretical wisdom, separates content/grounds/understanding and branch conditions, and reuses 24 source-bound empty audits from the old closure/joint-interpretation results. Full scope turns on substantive joint root warrant, not more examples or terminological translation; no new mathematical result.
